thread.title: A Director at Apple is Exercising Options

author: Carrie Williams
title: A Director at Apple is Exercising Options
text:
Carrie Williams - January 28, 2019, 6:54 PM EDT SHARE ON:
Today it was reported that a Director at Apple ( AAPL ), Albert Gore , exercised options to buy 35,000 AAPL shares at $14.51 a share, for a total transaction value of $507.9K. The options were close to expired and Albert Gore retained stocks.
This recent transaction increases Albert Gore’s holding in the company by 79.23% to a total of $12.38 million. Following Albert Gore’s last AAPL Buy transaction on February 08, 2018, the stock climbed by 2.9%.
Currently, Apple has an average volume of 26.17M. AAPL’s market cap is $750.1B and the company has a P/E ratio of 13.17.
24 different firms, including Merrill Lynch and BTIG, currently also have a Buy rating on the stock. Based on 36 analyst ratings, the analyst consensus is Moderate Buy with an average price target of $183.98, reflecting a 17.7% upside.
